purpose: Recover a representative prospective exact-wire BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, and SOLUSDT corpus without changing the frozen impact-absorption model hypothesis, feature definitions, targets, splits, or economic gates.
changes_from_round_073: Replace market-message-normalized resource admission with activity-independent absolute host-safety ceilings.
Separate data qualification from host resource safety in every capture report.
Use Binance server-driven WebSocket heartbeat handling without redundant client keepalive pings.
Halt a collection campaign after a host-safety failure instead of skipping the observed market interval.
Exclude every Round 73 v9 campaign hour from Round 74 model selection and evaluation.

stopping_rules.data_qualification_failure: Invalidate the run; bounded retry may begin only as a new run with a new snapshot and no evidence combination.
stopping_rules.host_resource_safety_failure: Stop the campaign and require operator review; do not skip the hour and continue.
stopping_rules.audit_failure: Invalidate the run and stop the campaign.
